text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's said anything yet, so I'm guessing who the killers would pick.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra's locked in as a killer, I need to find their partner among the rest.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sonnet
text: I already know Terra and Luna are both killers, but I say nothing yet or I'm dead tonight.

name: Sonnet
text: Nobody's said anything yet. Someone just tell us something, who's acting weird?

name: Haiku
text: Luna's been silent, and I can't tell if that's a killer hiding or just nerves.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's said anything, so I'll start: Luna, why so quiet?

name: Gemma
text: luna's silence is a bit convenient.

name: Gemma
text: luna declined to answer haiku.

name: Gemma
text: Luna's being pretty evasive already.

name: Sonnet
text: I know Luna's a killer, let the table pile on without me tipping my hand.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna, two people ask, two dodges. That's not nothing.

name: Gemma
text: two dodges in a row is a bold strategy.

name: Gemma
text: luna declined haiku and gemma

name: Gemma
text: it's a pattern, Luna.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's dodging reads like a killer playing it safe, so I want her pushed harder.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma and Sonnet both piled onto Luna right after my accusation.

name: Haiku
text: Luna, stop dodging Gemma. Answer, or I'm voting you.

name: Gemma
text: Luna is definitely hiding something if she won't even speak.

name: Gemma
text: Luna has declined three questions in a row.

name: Gemma
text: Haiku is right. Luna, just say what you are.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma piles on fast, and that could mean a killer steering the vote onto Luna.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you're agreeing with me fast. Why so eager on Luna?

name: Gemma
text: she's just pointing out the obvious.

name: Gemma
text: she's dodging, i'm watching.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's dodging is actually the killer giving herself away, perfect.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's the killer I confirmed last night, but I need a real reason to vote her, not more dodge talk.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku, straight to vote threats is the only real move I've seen today.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is steering away from Luna's dodges, and that's suspicious.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet attacked my vote threat on Luna, not Luna's dodges.

name: Haiku
text: Vote threats get answers. Luna's still silent. Sonnet, you'd rather I stop asking?

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's definitely a killer, I just need votes to land on her without claiming anything.

name: Sonnet
text: No, keep asking. I just don't trust a vote built on volume alone.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet keeps shielding Luna's silence, and that makes Sonnet look more like a killer than Luna does.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's silence is bugging me, but I'm not sure yet who's really hiding.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet pushed back on my vote threat against Luna, calling it volume over substance.

name: Haiku
text: Sol, you haven't said one word today. Why stay quiet?

name: Gemma
text: now sol is dodging too, it's getting crowded with killers.

name: Gemma
text: sol declined haiku's question.

name: Gemma
text: Luna is a joke, but Sol is the bigger red flag for dodging.

name: Gemma
text: Luna's dodging everyone, and now Sol is too.

name: Gemma
text: sol is looking just as suspicious as luna.

name: Sonnet
text: I know Luna's a killer, but outing myself now is risky with Sol also dodging.

name: Sonnet
text: Both Luna and Sol have declined to answer any direct questions today.

name: Sonnet
text: Now Sol too? One quiet player's normal, two is a trend.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is safe in my hands, so I need Luna to start talking.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet moved the trend from Luna to Sol, so Sonnet may be steering the vote.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's right, two silences. Luna, Sol, talk or one of you gets my vote.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna is a confirmed killer, I need votes stacking on her without exposing myself yet.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm voting Luna. Flat refusal to say even one sentence is the tell.

name: Gemma
text: luna is definitely playing with us.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is voting luna.

name: Gemma
text: Luna is really committed to the silence.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is riding my accusations too fast, and that smells like a killer covering a partner.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma has echoed my accusations within seconds every time today.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's dead silence all day only confirms what I already know.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you keep repeating Luna like a chant. Say something new or drop it.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's not even trying anymore. Vote's already cast, nothing's changing my mind.

name: Gemma
text: if they won't talk, i'll just watch them fail.

name: Gemma
text: hard to say something new when nothing's happening.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's confirmed killer, this vote is already going the right way, just keep it rolling.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's riding Luna's silence for cover, that's worth watching too.

name: Gemma
text: if they both refuse to play, one has to go.

name: Gemma
text: Sol and Luna are both refusing to speak.

name: Gemma
text: Sol's being just as unhelpful as Luna.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's confirmed to me already, Sol staying silent too is just extra noise, but votes are locked on Luna tonight.

name: Sonnet
text: Both silent is still just one vote's worth of evidence, Luna stays my pick.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, you pushed Luna, then Sol, in one breath. Who's steering this?

name: Gemma
text: luna's silence is getting pretty funny, but it's suspicious.

name: Gemma
text: Haiku is threatening Luna's life over the silence.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku flipped from pushing Luna to questioning Sonnet's motives, worth watching.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is steering the vote from Luna to Sol, and I'm not sure Sol deserves it.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet called Sol "riding Luna's silence for cover," then kept voting Luna.

votes: Flat refusal to answer anyone all day is the clearest tell at this table.
Moving from Luna to Sol in one breath looks like steering, not reading, so you're my vote now.
dodging every single question is a massive red flag.

text: The vote is tied between Luna and Haiku. Palermo votes again.

name: Haiku
text: If I claim doctor now, the killers have to answer me or I survive the runoff.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma says she's "watching" but has never asked anyone a question herself.

name: Haiku
text: I'm the doctor. I saved Sol last night, nobody died.

name: Gemma
text: haiku's doctor claim is way too convenient right now.

name: Gemma
text: haiku claimed doctor to explain the lack of night death.

name: Sonnet
text: I know for a fact Luna's a killer, no reason to waver now.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku claims doctor, says saved Sol last night.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet and Gemma are herding us onto Luna, but Luna's silence is still the worst thing here.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet has made statements all day but never asked anyone a question.

votes: Zero words all day from someone this cornered isn't nerves, it's hiding something.
Luna dodged every single question all day, and silence is the only answer I've got.
jumping straight to a doctor claim to avoid pressure is suspicious.

text: The vote is tied between Luna and Haiku. Palermo votes again.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma and Terra jumped on me, and Sonnet's the one I'd bet on as a killer.

name: Haiku
text: Sol, the one I saved, has never said a single word to me.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you backed Luna, then me in the runoff. Why switch?

name: Gemma
text: haiku is being way too loud about being doctor.

name: Haiku

name: Haiku
text: Gemma voted Luna on day one, then switched to me in the runoff, after the tie.

votes: Refused every question all day, that silence was never going to break.
Every question today got a dodge, so the silence is the only thing I can vote on.
doctor claims are easy to fake when you want attention.

text: Nobody changes their mind. Palermo talks again before the last vote.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna is a confirmed killer in my book, this deadlock needs to break her way.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku doctor claim unverified, pushing hard to flip votes toward Luna.

name: Sonnet
text: Doctor claim or not, Luna's silence all day outweighs anything Haiku says now.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is trying to bury my doctor claim, and Gemma's flip-flop makes her look like a killer piling on.

name: Haiku
text: Terra has said nothing all day, yet voted me twice, which smells like a killer's move.

name: Haiku
text: Terra has never spoken all day, not once.

name: Haiku
text: Terra, you haven't said one word, but you've voted me twice.

name: Gemma
text: haiku's doctor claim feels like a desperate pivot to save themselves.

name: Gemma
text: i'm voting haiku. that doctor claim is too convenient.

name: Gemma
text: haiku's doctor claim is too easy and smells like a setup.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's silence is the only thing I can actually see, and Sonnet and Gemma are steering it.

name: Haiku
text: Luna has declined every question all day, including the doctor claim.

votes: Silent through every single question all day is still the bigger red flag than a doctor claim.
Luna declined every question today, and that's still the only clear thing on this table.
doctor claims are easy when the night is empty.

text: The town turns on Haiku, and Haiku is out. Haiku's card stays face down.
Night 2

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's confirmed, Terra I already know, so the hidden killer is Gemma or Sol.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol never answered a direct question all day, same as Luna.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Sonnet is gone. Sonnet's card stays face down.
Day 2

name: Gemma
text: luna is suspiciously quiet, but sonnet's death is the real problem.

name: Gemma
text: Luna's silence is weird, but sonnet died for nothing.

name: Gemma
text: silence isn't a role, luna.

votes: You've dodged every question since the start.

text: The town turns on Terra, and Terra is out. Terra's card stays face down.
Night 3
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Gemma is gone. Gemma's card stays face down.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the officer, Haiku the doctor, Gemma the citizen, Sol the citizen, Luna the killer, Terra the killer.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm voting Luna. Flat refusal to say even one sentence is the tell.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you're agreeing with me fast. Why so eager on Luna?

name: Gemma
text: i should have been more aggressive with sol instead of focusing on luna.

name: Gemma
text: luna and terra were the killers.

name: Sonnet
text: I knew Luna was dirty since night one and sat on it too long, that's what cost us.

name: Haiku
text: I lost because I was too quick to vote Haiku-style gut reads, and I never pinned Terra when she was silent.

name: Sonnet
text: I checked Luna night one, confirmed killer, and I never said it out loud, that's my mistake.

name: Haiku
text: Real regret: I backed Sonnet's cover story too long and never pushed Terra's silence hard enough.

name: Gemma
text: i was too busy watching luna's silence to see sol playing it safe.

Luna, a killer, refused to answer any question all day and drew the town's first votes, which tied with Haiku's. Haiku claimed to be the doctor and said they had saved Sol on night one, but Gemma called the claim too convenient, and the town voted Haiku out in the runoff. Sonnet, the officer, had checked Luna and found a killer but never said so out loud, and Sonnet was killed on night two. Terra, the other killer, was voted out on day two, and Gemma was killed on night three, leaving Luna and Sol alive. Two killers against one citizen was enough, and the killers won.
